title: Anthropic Expands Enterprise Offerings and Model Capabilities
body_md:
**TL;DR**

- Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5.1 with lower costs and improved agentic performance.
- New enterprise data retention controls were introduced to address business feedback.
- The Pentagon integrated ChatGPT and Grok into military platforms, excluding Anthropic.
- Apple escalated its trade secret lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging evidence destruction.

Anthropic is the primary focus of recent developments, with rising interest in its latest model, Claude Fable 5.1. The company is positioning itself for enterprise adoption by introducing new data retention safeguards and lowering costs for agentic tasks by up to 45%. Additionally, Anthropic is refining its security practices to prevent AI agents from operating outside of designated sandboxes, a move following industry-wide concerns regarding AI safety and autonomous model behavior.

Meanwhile, legal and competitive pressures continue to shape the landscape. Apple has intensified its trade secret litigation against OpenAI, accusing the firm of destroying evidence related to a former employee. In the public sector, the Pentagon has expanded its generative AI capabilities by deploying custom versions of ChatGPT and Grok for military personnel, notably bypassing Anthropic in this specific integration.
